name: Spoke
author: Erin Carter
description: A starburst of glowing tubes radiating from the centre, charge shooting outward along each ray while the hue steps spoke to spoke. A softly lit ground fills the wedges between.

params.label: Scale
params.effect: Overall reference scale in CSS pixels - sets how quickly the rays thicken outward and how far the charge has to travel.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing ray in CSS pixels, from a hairline spoke to a fat neon beam.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge shooting outward along the rays; 0 freezes it, high fires bright pulses to the rim.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each ray; low is a crisp drawn spoke, high a luminous bloom flooding the wedges.

params.label: Rays
params.effect: Number of rays in the starburst, from a sparse compass rose to a dense radiant fan.
